name: ART 3610
title: Ceramics: Vessel Constructions
description: Investigation of principles, techniques, and processes for design and expression in ceramic art, with focus on the vessel form as cultural, historical, and contemporary object and idea. This course extends research, development, and realization of artistic concept in clay and glaze. Projects explore a range of fabrication skills, including hand building and wheelwork, and encourage inventive approaches to material, form, and surface. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: ART 2610; open only to Art majors, others by instructor consent.
